after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows built from a list of shifts."""

from collections import Counter
from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes


def _check(shifts: List[Shift]) -> None:
    if not shifts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts given")
    if any(not item.worker.strip() for item in shifts):
        raise ValueError("shift has a blank worker name")


def _row(name: str, count: int, minutes: int) -> str:
    hours = minutes / 60
    return f"{name}: {count} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours"


# ---
def timesheet_rows(shifts: Iterable[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, most hours first."""
    shifts = list(shifts)
    _check(shifts)
    counts = Counter(item.worker for item in shifts)
    totals = worker_minutes(shifts)
    order = sorted(totals, key=lambda name: (-totals[name], name))
    return [_row(name, counts[name], totals[name]) for name in order]
